company.description:
Bypa-ss is health-tech startup digitizing health information exchange in Egypt, empowering care providers and patients with better quality care. 

Our current main product is HealthTag, a multi-sided product that serves individuals, physicians, pharmacies, labs and radiology centers. 

More about HealthTag here: www.healthtag.me
More about Bypa-ss here: www.bypa-ss.com

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $1,000,000, or 86.96% of reported total funding.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,892,167 to $6,297,094, a 3.33x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
